format: ECMAScript Module (JavaScript with ES modules syntax)
description: This source file defines functions for managing bundled plugin build entries, including reading package.json files, collecting plugin source files, determining build configurations, and generating build artifacts for a plugin system. It facilitates plugin build configuration and artifact listing for a project that involves plugin packaging and distribution.

methods.name: readBundledPluginPackageJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a package.json file at a given path, returning null if the file does not exist or cannot be parsed.

methods.name: isManifestlessBundledRuntimeSupportPackage
methods.description: Determines if a package is a manifestless bundled runtime support package based on its name and publication entries.

methods.name: collectPluginSourceEntries
methods.description: Collects plugin source file entries from a package.json's openclaw.extensions and setupEntry fields.

methods.name: shouldStageBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Determines if runtime dependencies should be staged for a given package based on its openclaw.bundle configuration.

methods.name: collectTopLevelPublicSurfaceEntries
methods.description: Collects top-level public surface files in a plugin directory, filtering out test, declaration, config, and snapshot files.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Gathers all build entries for plugins in the extensions root, considering manifests and package.json info.

methods.name: listBundledPluginBuildEntries
methods.description: Creates a mapping of source entries to bundle file paths for plugins.

methods.name: listBundledPluginPackArtifacts
methods.description: Lists packaged artifact files (like JSON, JS, and package files) for plugins based on build entries.

methods.name: listBundledPluginRuntimeDependencies
methods.description: Lists runtime dependencies for plugins that require staging, based on their package.json dependencies.
